name: validateBehaviorSpecialization
says: A Behavior must not specialize a Structure.

name: validateParameterMembershipParameterDirection
says: The ownedMemberParameter of a ParameterMembership must have a direction equal to the result of the parameterDirection() operation.

name: validateParameterMembershipOwningType
says: A ParameterMembership must be owned by a Behavior,Step, or the result parameter of a ConstructorExpression.

name: validateFeatureChainExpressionOperator
says: The operator of a FeatureChainExpression must be ".".

name: validateFeatureChainExpressionConformance
says: The targetFeature of a FeatureChainExpression must be featured within the result parameter of the argument Expression of the FeatureChainExpression.

name: validateInstantiationExpressionResult
says: An InstantiationExpression must own its result parameter.

name: validateInstantiationExpressionInstantiatedType
says: An InstantiationExpression must have an InstantiatedType.

name: validateMetadataAccessExpressionReferencedElement
says: A MetadataAccessExpression must have at least one ownedMember that is not a FeatureMembership.

name: validateInvocationExpressionParameterRedefinition
ocl:
let parameters : OrderedSet(Feature) = instantiatedType.input in
input->forAll(inp | 
    inp.ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature->
        intersection(parameters)->size() = 1)
says: Each input parameter of an InvocationExpression must redefine exactly one input parameter of the instantiatedType of the InvocationExpression.

name: validateInvocationExpressionNoDuplicateParameterRedefinition
ocl:
let features : OrderedSet(Feature) = instantiatedType.feature in
input->forAll(inp1 | input->forAll(inp2 |
    inp1 <> inp2 implies
        inp1.ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature->
            intersection(inp2.ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature)->
            intersection(features)->isEmpty()))
says: Two different ownedFeatures of an InvocationExpression must not redefine the same feature of the instantiatedType of the InvocationExpression.

name: validateInvocationExpressionOwnedFeatures
ocl: ownedFeature->forAll(f | f <> result implies f.direction = FeatureDirectionKind::_'in')
says: Other than its result, all the ownedFeatures of an InvocationExpression must have direction = in.

name: validateInvocationExpressionInstantiatedType
ocl:
instantiatedType.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) or
instantiatedType.oclIsKindOf(Feature) and
    instantiatedType.type->exists(oclIsKindOf(Behavior)) and
    instantiatedType.type->size(1)
says: The instantiatedType of an InvocationExpression must be either a Behavior or a Feature with a single type, which is a Behavior.

name: validateConstructorExpressionNoDuplicateFeatureRedefinition
ocl:
let features : OrderedSet(Feature) = instantiatedType.feature->
    select(visibility = VisibilityKind::public) in
result.ownedFeature->forAll(f1 | result.ownedFeature->forAll(f2 |
    f1 <> f2 implies
        f1.ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature->
            intersection(f2.ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature)->
            intersection(features)->isEmpty()))
says: Two different ownedFeatures of the result of a ConstructorExpression must not redefine the same feature of the instantiatedType of the ConstructorExpression.

name: validateConstructorExpressionOwnedFeatures
says: A ConstructorExpression must not have any ownedFeatures other than its result.

name: validateSelectExpressionOperator
says: The operator of a SelectExpression must be 'select'.

name: validateFeatureReferenceExpressionReferentIsFeature
ocl:
let membership : Membership = 
    ownedMembership->reject(m | m.oclIsKindOf(ParameterMembership)) in
membership->notEmpty() and
membership->at(1).memberElement.oclIsKindOf(Feature)
says: The first ownedMembership of a FeatureReferenceExpression that is not a ParameterMembership must have a Feature as its memberElement.

name: validateFeatureReferenceExpressionResult
says: A FeatureReferenceExpression must own its result parameter.

name: validateCollectExpressionOperator
says: The operator of a CollectExpression must be "collect".

name: validateIndexExpressionOperator
says: The operator of an IndexExpression must be "#".

name: validateReturnParameterMembershipOwningType
says: The owningType of a ReturnParameterMembership must be a Function or Expression.

name: validateExpressionResultParameterMembership
says: An Expression must have exactly one featureMembership (owned or inherited) that is a ResultParameterMembership.

name: validateExpressionResultExpressionMembership
says: An Expression must have at most one ResultExpressionMembership.

name: validateResultExpressionMembershipOwningType
says: The owningType of a ResultExpressionMembership must be a Function or Expression.

name: validateFunctionResultParameterMembership
says: A Function must have exactly one featureMembership (owned or inherited) that is a ResultParameterMembership.

name: validateFunctionResultExpressionMembership
says: A Function must have at most one ResultExpressionMembership.

name: validateFlowPayloadFeature
says: A Flow must have at most one ownedFeature that is an PayloadFeature.

name: validateFlowEndIsEnd
says: A FlowEnd must be an end Feature.

name: validateFlowEndNestedFeature
says: A FlowEnd must have exactly one ownedFeature.

name: validateFlowEndOwningType
says: The owningType of a FlowEnd must be a Flow.

name: validateFeatureValueIsInitial
says: If a FeatureValue has isInitial = true, then its featureWithValue must have isVariable = true.

name: validateFeatureValueOverriding
says: All Features directly or indirectly redefined by the featureWithValue of a FeatureValue must have only default FeatureValues.

name: validateElementFilterMembershipConditionIsModelLevelEvaluable
says: The condition Expression must be model-level evaluable.

name: validateElementFilterMembershipConditionIsBoolean
says: The result parameter of the condition Expression must directly or indirectly specialize ScalarValues::Boolean.

name: validateMultiplicityRangeBoundResultTypes
ocl:
bound->forAll(b |
    b.result.specializesFromLibrary('ScalarValues::Integer') and
    let value : UnlimitedNatural = valueOf(b) in
    value <> null implies value >= 0
)
says: The results of the bound Expression(s) of a MultiplicityRange must be typed by ScalarValues::Intger from the Kernel Data Types Library. If a bound is model-level evaluable, then it must evaluate to a non-negative value.

name: validateMultiplicityRangeBounds
ocl:
if lowerBound = null then
    ownedMember->notEmpty() and
    ownedMember->at(1) = upperBound
else
    ownedMember->size() > 1 and
    ownedMember->at(1) = lowerBound and
    ownedMember->at(2) = upperBound
endif
says: The lowerBound (if any) and upperBound Expressions must be the first ownedMembers of a MultiplicityRange.

name: validateConnectorBinarySpecialization
says: If a Connector has more than two connectorEnds, then it must not specialize, directly or indirectly, the Association BinaryLink from the Kernel Semantic Library.

name: validateConnectorRelatedFeatures
says: If a Connector is concrete (not abstract), then it must have at least two relatedFeatures.

name: validateBindingConnectorIsBinary
says: A BindingConnector must be binary.

name: validateClassSpecialization
ocl:
ownedSpecialization.general->
    forAll(not oclIsKindOf(DataType)) and
not oclIsKindOf(Association) implies
    ownedSpecialization.general->
        forAll(not oclIsKindOf(Association))
says: A Class must not specialize a DataType and it can only specialize an Association if it is also itself a kind of Association (such as an AssociationStructure or Interaction).

name: validateMetadataFeatureMetaclass
says: A MetadataFeature must have exactly one type that is a Metaclass.

name: validateMetadataFeatureMetaclassNotAbstract
says: The metaclass of a MetadataFeature must not be abstract.

name: validateMetadataFeatureBody
ocl:
ownedFeature->closure(ownedFeature)->forAll(f |
    f.declaredName = null and f.declaredShortName = null and
    f.valuation <> null implies f.valuation.value.isModelLevelEvaluable and
    f.redefinition.redefinedFeature->size() = 1)
says: Each ownedFeature of a MetadataFeature must have no declared name, redefine a single Feature, either have no featureValue or a featureValue with a value Expression that is model-level evaluable, and only have ownedFeatures that also meet these restrictions.

name: validateMetadataFeatureAnnotatedElement
ocl:
let baseAnnotatedElementFeature : Feature =
    resolveGlobal('Metaobjects::Metaobject::annotatedElement').memberElement.
    oclAsType(Feature) in
let annotatedElementFeatures : OrderedSet(Feature) = feature->
    select(specializes(baseAnnotatedElementFeature))->
    excluding(baseAnnotatedElementFeature) in
annotatedElementFeatures->notEmpty() implies
    let annotatedElementTypes : Set(Feature) =
        annotatedElementFeatures.typing.type->asSet() in
    let metaclasses : Set(Metaclass) =
        annotatedElement.oclType().qualifiedName->collect(qn | 
            resolveGlobal(qn).memberElement.oclAsType(Metaclass)) in
   metaclasses->forAll(m | annotatedElementTypes->exists(t | m.specializes(t)))
says: The annotatedElements of a MetadataFeature must have an abstract syntax metaclass consistent with the annotatedElement declarations for the MetadataFeature.

name: validateStructureSpecialization
says: A Structure must not specialize a Behavior.

name: validateAssociationStructureIntersection
says: If an Association is also a kind of Structure, then it must be an AssociationStructure.

name: validateAssociationBinarySpecialization
says: If an Association has more than two associationEnds, then it must not specialize, directly or indirectly, the Association BinaryLink from the Kernel Semantic Library.

name: validateAssociationRelatedTypes
says: If an Association is concrete (not abstract), then it must have at least two relatedTypes.

name: validateAssociationEndTypes
says: The ownedEndFeatures of an Association must have exactly one type.

name: validateDataTypeSpecialization
ocl: ownedSpecialization.general-> forAll(not oclIsKindOf(Class) and not oclIsKindOf(Association))
says: A DataType must not specialize a Class or an Association.

name: validateTypeDifferencingTypesNotSelf
says: A Type cannot be one of its own differencingTypes.

name: validateTypeOwnedMultiplicity
says: A Type may have at most one ownedMember that is a Multiplicity.

name: validateTypeUnioningTypesNotSelf
says: A Type cannot be one of its own unioningTypes.

name: validateTypeOwnedIntersectingNotOne
says: A Type must not have exactly one ownedIntersecting.

name: validateTypeOwnedUnioningNotOne
says: A Type must not have exactly one ownedUnioning.

name: validateTypeAtMostOneConjugator
says: A Type must have at most one owned Conjugation Relationship.

name: validateTypeOwnedDifferencingNotOne
says: A Type must not have exactly one ownedDifferencing.

name: validateTypeIntersectingTypesNotSelf
says: A Type cannot be one of its own intersectingTypes.

name: validateSpecificationSpecificNotConjugated
says: The specific Type of a Specialization cannot be a conjugated Type.

name: validateClassifierMultiplicityDomain
says: If a Classifier has a multiplicity, then the multiplicity must have no featuringTypes (meaning that its domain is implicitly Base::Anything).

name: validateRedefinitionEndConformance
says: If the redefinedFeature of a Redefinition has isEnd = true, then the redefiningFeature must have isEnd = true.

name: validateRedefinitionFeaturingTypes
says: The redefiningFeature of a Redefinition must have at least one featuringType that is not also a featuringType of the redefinedFeature.

name: validateRedefinitionDirectionConformance
ocl:
let featuringTypes : Sequence(Type) =
    if redefiningFeature.isVariable then Sequence{redefiningFeature.owningType}
    else redefiningFeature.featuringType
    endif in
featuringTypes->forAll(t |
    let direction : FeatureDirectionKind = t.directionOf(redefinedFeature) in
    ((direction = FeatureDirectionKind::_'in' or 
      direction = FeatureDirectionKind::out) implies
         redefiningFeature.direction = direction)
    and 
    (direction = FeatureDirectionKind::inout implies
        redefiningFeature.direction <> null))
says: If the redefinedFeature of a Redefinition has a direction of in or out (relative to any featuringType of the redefiningFeature or the owningType, if the redefiningFeature has isVariable = true), then the redefiningFeature must have the same direction. If the redefinedFeature has a direction of inout, then the redefiningFeature must have a non-null direction. (Note: the direction of the redefinedFeature relative to a featuringType of the redefiningFeature is the direction it would have if it had been inherited and not redefined.)

name: validateFeatureEndNoDirection
says: A Feature with isEnd = true must have no direction.

name: validateFeatureEndIsConstant
says: A Feature with isEnd = true and isVariable = true must have isConstant = true.

name: validateFeatureIsVariable
says: A Feature with isVariable = true must have an owningType that directly or indirectly specializes the Class Occurrences::Occurrence from the Kernel Semantic Library.

name: validateFeatureChainingFeatureNotOne
says: A Feature must have either no chainingFeatures or more than one.

name: validateFeatureCrossFeatureType
says: The crossFeature of a Feature must have the same types as the Feature.

name: validateFeatureMultiplicityDomain
says: If a Feature has a multiplicity, then the featuringTypes of the multiplicity must be the same as those of the Feature itself.

name: validateFeatureChainingFeatureConformance
says: Each chainingFeature (other than the first) must be featured within the previous chainingFeature.

name: validateFeatureConstantIsVariable
says: A Feature with isConstant = true must have isVariable = true.

name: validateFeatureChainingFeaturesNotSelf
says: A Feature cannot be one of its own chainingFeatures.

name: validateFeatureOwnedCrossSubsetting
says: A Feature must have at most one ownedSubsetting that is a CrossSubsetting.

name: validateFeatureCrossFeatureSpecialization
ocl:
crossFeature <> null implies
    ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature.crossFeature->
            forAll(f | f <> null implies crossFeature.specializes(f))
says: If this Feature has a crossFeature, then, for any Feature that is redefined by this Feature, the crossFeature must specialize the crossFeature of the redefined end Feature, if this exists.

name: validateFeatureOwnedReferenceSubsetting
says: A Feature must have at most one ownedSubsetting that is an ReferenceSubsetting.

name: validateFeatureEndMultiplicity
says: If a Feature has isEnd = true, then it must have multiplicity 1..1.

name: validateFeatureEndNotDerivedAbstractCompositeOrPortion
ocl: isEnd implies not (isDerived or isAbstract or isComposite or isPortion)
says: A Feature with isEnd = true must have all of isDerived = false, isAbstract = false, isComposite = false, and isPortion = false.

name: validateSubsettingConstantConformance
says: If the subsettedFeature of a Subsetting has isConstant = true and the subsettingFeature has isVariable = true, then the subsettingFeature must have isConstant = true.

name: validateSubsettingUniquenessConformance
says: If the subsettedFeature of a Subsetting has isUnique = true, then the subsettingFeature must have isUnique = true.

name: validateSubsettingFeaturingTypes
says: The subsettedFeature must be accessible by the subsettingFeature.

name: validateEndFeatureMembershipIsEnd
says: The ownedMemberFeature of an EndFeatureMembership must be an end Feature.

name: validateCrossSubsettingCrossedFeature
ocl:
crossingFeature.isEnd and crossingFeature.owningType <> null implies
    let endFeatures: Sequence(Feature) = crossingFeature.owningType.endFeature in
    let chainingFeatures: Sequence(Feature) = crossedFeature.chainingFeature in
    chainingFeatures->size() = 2 and
    endFeatures->size() = 2 implies 
        chainingFeatures->at(1) = endFeatures->excluding(crossingFeature)->at(1)
says: The crossedFeature of a CrossSubsetting must have exactly two chainingFeatures. If the crossingFeature of the CrossSubsetting is one of two end Features, then the first chainingFeature must be the other end Feature.

name: validateCrossSubsettingCrossingFeature
says: The crossingFeature of a CrossSubsetting must be an end Feature that is owned by a Type with at least two end Features.

name: validateAnnotationAnnotatingElement
says: Either the ownedAnnotatingElement of an Annotation must be non-null, or the owningAnnotatingElement must be non-null, but not both.

name: validateAnnotationAnnotatedElementOwnership
says: An Annotation owns its annotatingElement if and only if it is owned by its annotatedElement.

name: validateImportTopLevelVisibility
says: A top-level Import (that is, one that is owned by a root Namespace) must have a visibility of private.

name: validateNamespaceDistinguishibility
ocl: membership->forAll(m1 | membership->forAll(m2 | m1 <> m2 implies m1.isDistinguishableFrom(m2)))
says: All memberships of a Namespace must be distinguishable from each other.

name: validateElementIsImpliedIncluded
says: If an Element has any ownedRelationships for which isImplied = true, then the Element must also have isImpliedIncluded = true. (Note that an Element can have isImplied = true even if no ownedRelationships have isImplied = true, indicating the Element simply has no implied Relationships.

name: validateFlowDefinitionFlowEnds
says: A FlowDefinition may not have more than two flowEnds.

name: validateEnumerationDefinitionIsVariation
says: An EnumerationDefinition must be a variation.

name: validateRequirementUsageSubjectParameterPosition
says: The subjectParameter of a RequirementUsage must be its first input.

name: validateRequirementUsageOnlyOneSubject
says: A RequirementDefinition must have at most one featureMembership that is a SubjectMembership.

name: validateFramedConcernMembershipConstraintKind
says: A FramedConcernMembership must have kind = requirement.

name: validateActorMembershipOwningType
ocl:
owningType.oclIsKindOf(RequirementUsage) or
owningType.oclIsKindOf(RequirementDefinition) or
owningType.oclIsKindOf(CaseDefinition) or
owningType.oclIsKindOf(CaseUsage)
says: The owningType of an ActorMembership must be a RequirementDefinition, RequirementUsage, CaseDefinition, or CaseUsage.

name: validateStakeholderMembershipOwningType
says: The owningType of a StakeholderMembership must be a RequirementDefinition or RequirementUsage.

name: validateSubjectMembershipOwningType
says: The owningType of a SubjectMembership must be a RequirementDefinition, RequirementUsage, CaseDefinition, or CaseUsage.

name: validateRequirementDefinitionOnlyOneSubject
says: A RequirementDefinition must have at most one featureMembership that is a SubjectMembership.

name: validateRequirementDefinitionSubjectParameterPosition
says: The subjectParameter of a RequirementDefinition must be its first input.

name: validateRequirementConstraintMembershipIsComposite
says: The ownedConstraint of a RequirementConstraintMembership must be composite.

name: validateRequirementConstraintMembershipOwningType
says: The owningType of a RequirementConstraintMembership must be a RequirementDefinition or a RequirementUsage.

name: validateSatisfyRequirementUsageReference
says: If a SatisfyRequirementUsage has an ownedReferenceSubsetting, then the featureTarget of its referencedFeature must be a RequirementUsage.

name: validateAssertConstraintUsageReference
says: If an AssertConstraintUsage has an ownedReferenceSubsetting, then the featureTarget of its referencedFeature must be a ConstraintUsage.

name: validateCaseUsageSubjectParameterPosition
says: The subjectParameter of a CaseUsage must be its first input.

name: validateCaseUsageOnlyOneObjective
says: A CaseUsage must have at most one featureMembership that is a ObjectiveMembership.

name: validateCaseUsageOnlyOneSubject
says: A CaseUsage must have at most one featureMembership that is a SubjectMembership.

name: validateCaseDefinitionSubjectParameterPosition
says: The subjectParameter of a CaaseDefinition must be its first input.

name: validateCaseDefinitionOnlyOneObjective
says: A CaseDefinition must have at most one featureMembership that is a ObjectiveMembership.

name: validateCaseDefinitionOnlyOneSubject
says: A CaseDefinition must have at most one featureMembership that is a SubjectMembership.

name: validateObjectiveMembershipOwningType
says: The owningType of an ObjectiveMembership must be a CaseDefinition or CaseUsage.

name: validateObjectiveMembershipIsComposite
says: The ownedObjectiveRequirement of an ObjectiveMembership must be composite.

name: validateTransitionFeatureMembershipGuardExpression
ocl:
kind = TransitionFeatureKind::guard implies
    transitionFeature.oclIsKindOf(Expression) and
    let guard : Expression = transitionFeature.oclIsKindOf(Expression) in
    guard.result.specializesFromLibrary('ScalarValues::Boolean') and
    guard.result.multiplicity <> null and
    guard.result.multiplicity.hasBounds(1,1)
says: If the kind of a TransitionUsage is guard, then its transitionFeature must be a kind of Expression whose result is a Boolean value.

name: validateTransitionFeatureMembershipOwningType
says: The owningType of a TransitionFeatureMembership must be a TransitionUsage.

name: validateTransitionFeatureMembershipEffectAction
says: If the kind of a TransitionUsage is effect, then its transitionFeature must be a kind of ActionUsage.

name: validateTransitionFeatureMembershipTriggerAction
says: If the kind of a TransitionUsage is trigger, then its transitionFeature must be a kind of AcceptActionUsage.

name: validateExhibitStateUsageReference
says: If an ExhibitStateUsage has an ownedReferenceSubsetting, then the featureTarget of the referencedFeature must be a StateUsage.

name: validateStateSubactionMembershipOwningType
says: The owningType of a StateSubactionMembership must be a StateDefinition or a StateUsage.

name: validateStateUsageParallelSubactions
says: If a StateUsage is parallel, then its nestedActions (which includes nestedStates) must not have any incomingTransitions or outgoingTransitions.

name: validateStateUsageStateSubactionKind
says: A StateUsage must not have more than one owned StateSubactionMembership of each kind.

name: validateStateDefinitionParallelSubactions
says: If a StateDefinition is parallel, then its ownedActions (which includes its ownedStates) must not have any incomingTransitions or outgoingTransitions.

name: validateStateDefinitionStateSubactionKind
says: A StateDefinition must not have more than one owned StateSubactionMembership of each kind.

name: validateTransitionUsageSuccession
ocl:
let successions : Sequence(Successions) = 
    ownedMember->selectByKind(Succession) in
successions->notEmpty() and
successions->at(1).targetFeature.featureTarget->
    forAll(oclIsKindOf(ActionUsage))
says: A TransitionUsage must have an ownedMember that is a Succession with an ActionUsage as the featureTarget of its targetFeature.

name: validateTransitionUsageTriggerActions
ocl: source <> null and not source.oclIsKindOf(StateUsage) implies triggerAction->isEmpty()
says: If the source of a TransitionUsage is not a StateUsage, then the TransitionUsage must not have any triggerActions.

name: validateTransitionUsageParameters
ocl: if triggerAction->isEmpty() then inputParameters()->size() >= 1 else inputParameters()->size() >= 2 endif
says: A TransitionUsage must have at least one owned input parameter and, if it has a triggerAction, it must have at least two.

name: validateIncludeUseCaseUsageReference
says: If an IncludeUseCaseUsage has an ownedReferenceSubsetting, then the featureTarget of the referencedFeature must be a UseCaseUsage.

name: validatePerformActionUsageReference
says: If a PerformActionUsage has an ownedReferenceSubsetting, then the featureTarget of the referencedFeature must be an ActionUsage.

name: validateAssignmentActionUsageReferent
says: An AssignmentActionUsage must have an ownedMembership that is not an OwningMembership and whose memberElement is a Feature.

name: validateAssignmentActionUsage
says: The featureTarget of the referent of an AssignmentActionUsage must be able to have time-varying values.

name: validateForLoopActionUsageLoopVariable
says: The first ownedFeature of a ForLoopActionUsage must be a ReferenceUsage.

name: validateForLoopActionUsageParameters
says: A ForLoopActionUsage must have two owned input parameters.

name: validateTriggerInvocationExpressionAfterArgument
ocl:
kind = TriggerKind::after implies
    argument->notEmpty() and
    argument->at(1).result.specializesFromLibrary('Quantities::ScalarQuantityValue') and
    let mRef : Element = 
        resolveGlobal('Quantities::TensorQuantityValue::mRef').ownedMemberElement in
    argument->at(1).result.feature->
        select(ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature->
           closure(ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature)->
           includes(mRef))->
        exists(specializesFromLibrary('ISQBase::DurationUnit'))
says: If a TriggerInvocationExpression has kind = after, then it must have an argument Expression with a result that conforms to the type Quantities::ScalarQuantityValue and a feature that directly or indirectly redefines Quantities::TensorQuantityValue::mRef and directly or indirectly specializes ISQBase::DurationUnit.

name: validateTriggerInvocationExpressionAtArgument
says: If a TriggerInvocationExpression has kind = at, then it must have an argument Expression with a result that conforms to the type Time::TimeInstantValue.

name: validateTriggerInvocationExpressionWhenArgument
ocl:
kind = TriggerKind::when implies
    argument->notEmpty() and
    argument->at(1).oclIsKindOf(FeatureReferenceExpression) and
    let referent : Feature = 
        argument->at(1).oclAsType(FeatureReferenceExpression).referent in
    referent.oclIsKindOf(Expression) and
    referent.oclAsType(Expression).result.specializesFromLibrary('ScalarValues::Boolean')
says: If a TriggerInvocationExpression has kind = when, then it must have an argument that is a FeatureReferenceExpression whose referent is an Expression with a result that conforms to the type ScalarValues::Boolean.

name: validateDecisionNodeIncomingSuccessions
says: A DecisionNode may have at most one incoming Succession.

name: validateDecisionNodeOutgoingSuccessions
says: All outgoing Successions from a DecisionNode must have a target multiplicity of 0..1.

name: validateForkNodeIncomingSuccessions
says: A ForkNode may have at most one incoming Succession.

name: validateJoinNodeOutgoingSuccessions
says: A JoinNode may have at most one outgoing Succession.

name: validateControlNodeOwningType
says: The owningType of a ControlNode must be an ActionDefinition or ActionUsage.

name: validateControlNodeIncomingSuccessions
says: All incoming Successions to a ControlNode must have a target multiplicity of 1..1.

name: validateControlNodeOutgoingSuccessions
says: All outgoing Successions from a ControlNode must have a source multiplicity of 1..1.

name: validateControlNodeIsComposite
says: A ControlNode must be composite.

name: validateMergeNodeOutgoingSuccessions
says: A MergeNode may have at most one outgoing Succession.

name: validateMergeNodeIncomingSuccessions
says: All incoming Successions to a MergeNode must have a source multiplicity of 0..1.

name: validateAcceptActionUsageParameters
says: An AcceptUsageAction must have at least two input parameters, corresponding to its payload and receiver, respectively (even if they have no FeatureValue). (Note that the payloadParameter is an input as well as an output.)

name: validateWhileLoopActionUsage
says: A WhileLoopActionUsage must have at least two owned input parameters.

name: validateSendActionParameters
says: A SendActionUsage must have at least three owned input parameters, corresponding to its payload, sender and receiver, respectively (whether or not they have FeatureValues).

name: validateIfActionUsageParameters
says: An IfActionUsage must have at least two owned input parameters.

name: validateEventOccurrenceUsageReference
says: If an EventOccurrenceUsage has an ownedReferenceSubsetting, then the featureTarget of the referencedFeature must be an OccurrenceUsage.

name: validateEventOccurrenceUsageIsReference
says: An EventOccurrenceUsage must be referential.

name: validateOccurrenceUsageIndividualDefinition
says: An OccurrenceUsage must have at most one occurrenceDefinition with isIndividual = true.

name: validateOccurrenceUsageIndividualUsage
says: If an OccurrenceUsage has isIndividual = true, then it must have an individualDefinition.

name: validateOccurrenceUsageIsPortion
says: If an OccurrenceUsage has a non-null portionKind, then it must have isPortion = true.

name: validateOccurrenceUsagePortionKind
ocl:
portionKind <> null implies
    owningType <> null and
    (owningType.oclIsKindOf(OccurrenceDefinition) or
     owningType.oclIsKindOf(OccurrenceUsage))
says: If an OccurrenceUsage has a non-null portionKind, then its owningType must be an OccurrenceDefinition or an OccurrenceUsage.

name: validateUsageVariationIsAbstract
says: If a Usage is a variation, then it must be abstract.

name: validateUsageVariationOwnedFeatureMembership
says: If a Usage is a variation, then it must not have any ownedFeatureMemberships.

name: validateUsageVariationSpecialization
ocl:
isVariation implies
    not ownedSpecialization.specific->exists(
        oclIsKindOf(Definition) and
        oclAsType(Definition).isVariation or
        oclIsKindOf(Usage) and
        oclAsType(Usage).isVariation)
says: A variation Usage may not specialize any variation Definition or Usage.

name: validateUsageIsReferential
ocl: direction <> null or isEnd or featuringType->isEmpty() implies isReference
says: A Usage that is directed, an end feature or has no featuringTypes must be referential.

name: validateReferenceUsageIsReference
says: A ReferenceUsage is always referential.

name: validateVariantMembershipOwningNamespace
says: The membershipOwningNamespace of a VariantMembership must be a variation-point Definition or Usage.

name: validateDefinitionVariationSpecialization
ocl:
isVariation implies
    not ownedSpecialization.specific->exists(
        oclIsKindOf(Definition) and
        oclAsType(Definition).isVariation)
says: A variation Definition may not specialize any other variation Definition.

name: validateDefinitionVariationIsAbstract
says: If a Definition is a variation, then it must be abstract.

name: validateDefinitionVariationOwnedFeatureMembership
says: If a Definition is a variation, then all it must not have any ownedFeatureMemberships.

name: validateAttributeDefinitionFeatures
says: All features of an AttributeDefinition must be non-composite.

name: validateAttributeUsageIsReference
says: An AttributeUsage is always referential.

name: validateAttributeUsageFeatures
says: All features of an AttributeUsage must be non-composite.

name: validatePartUsagePartDefinition
says: At least one of the itemDefinitions of a PartUsage must be a PartDefinition.

name: validateConjugatedPortDefinitionConjugatedPortDefinitionIsEmpty
says: A ConjugatedPortDefinition must not itself have a conjugatedPortDefinition.

name: validateConjugatedPortDefinitionOriginalPortDefinition
says: The originalPortDefinition of the ownedPortConjugator of a ConjugatedPortDefinition must be the originalPortDefinition of the ConjugatedPortDefinition.

name: validatePortDefinitionOwnedUsagesNotComposite
says: The ownedUsages of a PortDefinition that are not PortUsages must not be composite.

name: validatePortDefinitionConjugatedPortDefinition
ocl:
not oclIsKindOf(ConjugatedPortDefinition) implies
    ownedMember->
        selectByKind(ConjugatedPortDefinition)->
        size() = 1
says: Unless it is a ConjugatedPortDefinition, a PortDefinition must have exactly one ownedMember that is a ConjugatedPortDefinition.

name: validatePortUsageNestedUsagesNotComposite
says: The nestedUsages of a PortUsage that are not themselves PortUsages must not be composite.

name: validatePortUsageIsReference
ocl: owningType = null or not owningType.oclIsKindOf(PortDefinition) and not owningType.oclIsKindOf(PortUsage) implies isReference
says: Unless a PortUsage has an owningType that is a PortDefinition or a PortUsage, it must be referential (non-composite).

name: validateViewUsageOnlyOneViewRendering
says: A ViewUsage must have at most one ViewRenderingMembership.

name: validateExposeVisibility
says: An Expose always has protected visibility.

name: validateExposeIsImportAll
says: An Expose always imports all Elements, regardless of visibility.

name: validateExposeOwningNamespace
says: The importOwningNamespace of an Expose must be a ViewUsage.

name: validateViewDefinitionOnlyOneViewRendering
says: A ViewDefinition must have at most one ViewRenderingMembership.

name: validateViewRenderingMembershipOwningType
says: The owningType of a ViewRenderingMembership must be a ViewDefinition or a ViewUsage.

name: validateConnectionDefinitionIsSufficient
says: A ConnectionDefinition must have isSufficient = true.

name: validateRequirementVerificationMembershipOwningType
says: The owningType of a RequirementVerificationMembership must a RequirementUsage that is owned by an ObjectiveMembership.

name: validateRequirementVerificationMembershipKind
says: A RequirementVerificationMembership must have kind = requirement.
